request.description: `launch` runs a program; `attach` connects to the REPL kernel's netrepl process

program.description: launch: the Janet file to run

args.description: launch: command line arguments, also passed to `main`

env.description: launch: environment variables on top of the worktree's

stopOnEntry.description: launch: stop before the first top-level form

port.description: attach: the netrepl port (default: the one the REPL kernel recorded for this worktree)
